sample.title: Home sample collection
sample.lede: A trained phlebotomist visits your address, collects the sample and delivers it to the laboratory. Reports reach you through the patient portal.

step1.title: Request a visit
step1.body: Tell us your address, the tests you need and a preferred time.

step2.title: We confirm
step2.body: Our team calls to confirm the slot, preparation rules and any fee.

step3.title: Sample collected
step3.body: A technician arrives with sealed, single-use collection equipment.

step4.title: Report delivered
step4.body: Results are released to your patient portal once reviewed.

about.title: About CarePilot
about.lede: A diagnostic and clinical centre network built around clear information and calm patient journeys.
about.missionBody: To make diagnostic care understandable, reachable and respectful of people's time.
about.goal1: Publish clear preparation and pricing information for every test.
about.goal2: Keep specialist doctors reachable across the network.
about.goal3: Bring diagnostics closer to home through sample collection.
about.goal4: Hold health content to a documented clinical review process.
about.value3Body: Everyone should be able to use the service.
about.leadershipLede: The people accountable for how we run.
about.noticeDisclaimer: This is a demonstration dataset. Organisation, clinical and pricing details must be verified before publication.
